title: Solo leveling: damage first, self-sustain built in
why: Kill fast alone: the Chain of Torment → Condemnation loop, crit-boosted by Earth Punishment; Radiant Benediction and Light of Regeneration keep you up.

skills.why: Main damage, 3 s cooldown, always crits on Earth Punishment's target; spec: +12% vs fewer targets.
Condemnation only hits targets it marks; 4-target DoT. Spec pick: read in game.
Held left click, 110 MP a hit keeps the loop fed; spec: +20% MP restored.
No-cooldown 4-target filler; spec: +12% vs fewer targets (−20% MP if MP runs short).
Free damage every 30 s; spec: Changes to AoE Skill, for packs.
Biggest hit, fully charged by hand; 8 at 36, 10 at 38; spec: +30% Skill Speed.
10 s 4-target DoT; spec: −15% target Defense.
Manual self-heal on a 6 s cooldown; spec: +2 consecutive uses.
30 s heal over time in the macro; spec: +20% healed at 50% HP or less.
Burst heal and cleanse for elites; spec: removes up to 2 debuffs.
+100 Crit and extra damage on every hit; the best damage passive.
+10.5% Crit Damage; finish it with Wisdom Stone points past the 203 from levels.

stigmas.why: Toggle on yourself: +10.5% damage and tolerance for 1 point; keep it out of the macro.
30 s DoT nuke; from stigma level 5 Condemnation always crits on its target.
300 s pet aura that attacks with you; recast after each death or teleport.
+20% Attack for 10 s on elites and big pulls; press it by hand.

macros.name: Solo loop
macros.key: Right Mouse Button (hold with Left Mouse)
macros.why: Hold both mouse buttons: cooldowns fire as they come up, Judgment Thunder fills, left click weaves Earth's Retribution for MP.

steps.note: Entry 1: 30 s DoT that makes Condemnation crit
Entry 3: self-heal over time on cooldown
Entry 4: marks the target; Condemnation needs it
Entry 5: 10 s DoT, cuts Defense with its spec
Entry 6: main hit, lands only on a marked target
Entry 7: no-cooldown filler, last so it never starves the rest

title: Group dungeon healer: heal first, damage between heals
why: Party healer that still deals damage: heals maxed, Light of Protection for the party, Chain of Torment on the boss, a resurrection slotted.

skills.why: Workhorse heal on the lowest ally every 6 s; spec: +2 consecutive uses.
Party heal and cleanse every 12 s; spec: removes up to 2 debuffs.
30 s party heal over time in the macro; spec: +20% healed at 50% HP or less.
Boss −5% Tolerance for the party (−10% more needs skill 12); enables Condemnation.
Damage between heals, which chests also count; spec: +12% vs fewer targets.
Left-click MP source for long fights; spec: +20% MP restored.
No-cooldown filler on the boss and adds; spec: +12% vs fewer targets.
Cuts the boss's damage 5%; spec: −15% target Defense.
Free damage every 30 s within 20 m of the boss; spec pick: read in game.
Turns Attack into Heal Boost, so every Attack stat also heals.
Charged by hand in safe windows for stagger; low priority for a healer.

stigmas.why: +10.5% PvE damage and tolerance for the whole party; 87% of top Clerics run it.
Guaranteed-crit Condemnations on the boss from stigma level 5, plus Earth's Blessing for the party.
Only class resurrection; hold it until the group clears mechanics cleanly.
Free damage for 300 s; swap Resurrection for Prayer of Amplification once nobody dies.

macros.name: Dungeon loop
macros.key: Right Mouse Button (hold with Left Mouse)
macros.why: Keeps the party HoT and boss debuffs rolling while you hold it; release to cast Healing Light or Radiant Recovery by hand.

steps.note: Entry 1: party HoT on every cooldown
Entry 2: 30 s DoT, Condemnation crits on its target
Entry 3: free damage every 30 s near the boss
Entry 4: boss Tolerance debuff; Condemnation needs it
Entry 6: damage between heals, on a marked target
Entry 7: filler, last so it never starves the rest
